list.author: Sarah M., Johannesburg
list.text: Our little dachshund Rosie came to us perfectly socialised and so full of love. The whole experience with Luminé was wonderful — they clearly care deeply about every puppy.

list.author: David & Lisa K., Cape Town
list.text: Our English Bulldog Winston is the most gentle, well-tempered dog. Luminé Kennels answered every question patiently and kept us updated throughout. Highly recommend!

list.author: Annamarie V., Pretoria
list.text: Second puppy from Luminé and each time the experience has been exceptional. You can tell these dogs are raised with so much love — it shows in their temperament.
